descriptive_title: Kindergarten Mathematics: Demonstrations — Spatial Sense and 2D/3D Shapes (A9.1-A9.7)
short_description: A 5-day Kindergarten unit on spatial sense framed around Sammy the Safari Sloth and Mira the Map-Making Monkey. Children identify 2D and 3D shapes, use position words, compose and decompose, and create shape art.
long_description: Take your Kindergarten class on a Shape Safari with Sammy the Safari Sloth and Mira the Map-Making Monkey! This 5-day Ontario-aligned unit covers all 7 spatial sense expectations (A9.1-A9.7) through play-based, hands-on exploration. Day 1 introduces 2D shapes (circle, triangle, square, rectangle, hexagon). Day 2 introduces 3D shapes (sphere, cube, cylinder, cone, pyramid) and the flat-vs-solid distinction. Day 3 brings positional language (above, below, beside, inside, outside, between) through Mira's safari treasure map. Day 4 teaches compose and decompose using paper pattern blocks and 3D models. Day 5 closes with a Safari Art Capstone where children integrate everything into a shape-built picture. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a specific Grade-3 trap), 5 student worksheets (with answer keys), 12 paper manipulatives (2D shape set, 3D models, safari map mat, position word cards, pattern blocks, capstone template, anchor charts, animal tokens, anchor poster, two character puppets), a mid-unit formative check, an end-of-unit reflection sheet, a class diagnostic checklist, three formative trackers, a 6-row summative rubric on Ontario's 4-level scale, a summative task script with phase-by-phase administration guidance, and Junior Shape Explorer certificates. Pedagogical approach: hands-on play-based learning with explicit vocabulary instruction, structured pair work, and rich teacher-puppet narrative.
